title: The Fortnight
subtitle: — what shipped, hardened, and compounded
lede: Two weeks that moved on three fronts at once: client surfaces that face money, governance substrate that earns trust, and security that closes ruin. The structural win underneath — the shift from hand-crafted artifacts to rendered families from a single source of truth.
trace_caption: Peak 08‑07 (87) — the forge/omakase build crest. One quiet day (08‑12).

items.html: Counterpart-forge became a product — parameterized CLI, the 5-surface family (onedoor · receipt · codex · diamond · profile), gate-hardened into one canonical pipeline. Robin = platinum master, Yuri = acceptance test.
Louisville universe, end to end — pitch suite, The Board cast, tiered Offer, present mode, Phase-2 persistence (SessionReceipt + API + Studio), least-privilege DB role.
Omakase pipeline generalized — jeben → omakase → louisville; coursed L1/L2/L3, the atom story, the guest's live receipt + take-home gift.
Ahmed reconnect — 3-surface ext + the 60-second chronograph onramp (the consumability fix). Rayan/Periscope one-door.
Public federated family on arcs.care — playground + monolith + 4 performers, two-layer air-gap.
Tao / pricing / OSS-family canon — dormant-seed doctrine, free-to-hold/metered-to-fire, the _SEEDS bank, the germinate open↔private boundary, the connector pattern.
lab-mint factory + serializable state; Rosetta operational-definitions registry.
Positioning sharpened — honest resonance engine, not propaganda; magnetic best-fit.
The sequence oracle — a git-serialized ID authority. oracle next adr — no session hand-guesses a number again.
Forensic ADR reconciliation — 4 auditors traced ~43 refs to ground truth; colliding namespace fixed at forensic grade.
Drift machinery — drift-receipt gate, lattice + seedbank inchworms, surface/DEWY watches.
Quality gates — temporal-provenance, model-tier routing, hypercube gauntlet + sampler, two-pass fidelity grader.

clusters.title: Security
clusters.sub: quietly some of the biggest wins

items.html: Closed multiple RUIN-class leaks — jeben thread book, omakase appendix, recoil canvas, canon-manifest.json were all world-readable. Pulled off public surfaces.
CISO/SRE hardening — Studio (append-only, 405s, logging) + Louisville anon API; tenant-wide read gated.
Restored a witness receipt clobbered in a merge (lost-update fix); private-repo receipts for chan/status.

clusters.title: Meta-capability
clusters.sub: the wins that make the next wins cheaper

items.html: Instance → class proved repeatable — forge and omakase each went one-off → parameterized family. The template is now the deliverable.
~20 durable memories (fork-when-dense · mechanical-pass-first · git-is-the-write-lock · render-fidelity-is-two-way), 20 ADRs, ~24 tools — substrate compounding, not just shipping.

fronts.b: forge · louisville · omakase · ahmed — surfaces a counterpart can actually read.
gauntlets · gates · oracle · inchworms — drift becomes a receipt, not a surprise.
world-readable leaks closed before they cost anything.

through.punch_html: The single largest structural win is the move from hand-crafted artifacts to rendered families from SSOT — the same shift that made the sequence oracle and the OSS-family seed bank possible in a single session at the close of the fortnight.
